deployments_detail.use: First Israeli financial services company to integrate Microsoft Azure OpenAI into business processes, enabling advanced AI models for customer service

First insurer/financial-services firm in Israel to integrate Microsoft Azure OpenAI (GPT) into service operations — automatic summarization of customer interactions from CRM data, prior emails, chats and call transcripts so reps grasp customer history within seconds. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI (GPT), OpenAI]

Azure OpenAI ChatGPT-style natural-language knowledge search / agent-assist rolled out to hundreds of Harel service-center employees to query internal knowledge bases and documentation and auto-generate/email call summaries. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI (GPT)]

AI-based voice BOT / cognitive IVR that understands free-form spoken Hebrew and routes calls by intent using a machine-learning engine (no touch-tone), plus digital self-service — described as first-of-its-kind call center in Israel. [none]

"Opti Web" automated online underwriting engine for life and health insurance — gives agents instant decisions on acceptance terms, personalized premium and required medical loadings from the health declaration, with underwriting rules maintained by the underwriting dept. [Harel (in-house Opti Web)]

In-house AI division building AI platforms, LLM-based "smart agents" and advanced RAG applications embedded directly into the company's core insurance/finance processes (per Harel AI-division engineering roles). [none]

CIO Shai Galila: Harel currently uses smart AI (LLMs) mainly for operational efficiency and improving service to customers and agents, with a stated plan to intensify deployment of AI agents through 2026. [none]

Partnership with Multyx to adopt its SaaS cloud platform for AI, ML and GenAI — enabling new data-driven applications and AI solutions "not previously feasible" to streamline business processes. [Multyx]
Prior collaboration with Microsoft Israel on data management and actuarial risk modeling, cited as the foundation for Harel's later Azure OpenAI adoption. [Microsoft]
